prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: ["Verify & Claim Your Pet", "Confirm your pet details and claim your official certificate.", "Verified Companion"]
1: ["How to Interact with Your Pet", "Click your pet to talk, right-click for settings menu, or double-click to hide it in your system tray.", "Right-click anytime on the pet desktop icon for quick controls."]
2: ["Welcome to Your Desktop Companion", "Explore how a virtual companion keeps you company while you work and play.", "Choose Your Path", "Select a ready-made companion or build your own custom pet."]
3: ["Preparing Your Pet for Desktop Launch", "We are generating your pet animations and configuring desktop window overlay settings.", "Initializing desktop pet engine..."]
4: ["Signing in syncs your existing pets and progress automatically across all desktop devices.", "Cloud sync enabled: existing pets will load immediately after sign in."]
5: ["Your pet will automatically appear on your desktop once rendering finishes."]
6: ["Select Your Ideal Companion", "Playful & Active", "Calm Work Buddy"]
7: ["Your Pet is Live on Your Desktop!", "Look at the bottom corner of your screen to meet your new pet.", "Hi! I am live on your desktop. Click me anytime to interact!"]
8: ["Pick Your Companion Path", "Select a pre-made pet or build a custom pet (takes under 2 minutes)."]
9: ["For best results, upload clear front-facing photos with good lighting and clear face outlines.", "Select Clear Front View Photo"]

verdicts.problem: Requests personal information by asking the user to upload photos of their face.
